It is, without question, the best GP surgery I’ve attended for many years — and it just keeps getting better. Every member of the team is attentive, professional, and genuinely caring, which makes such a difference when you need support with your health.

I especially want to recognise Dr Boughton, who is truly exceptional. She is kind, compassionate, and takes the time to really listen and understand your concerns. You never feel rushed, and she goes above and beyond to make sure you get the right care including referrals when needed so that issues are properly addressed. It’s rare to find a doctor who combines such professionalism with such genuine warmth and dedication to patients. I’m honestly lost for words when trying to describe how good she is, but I’m incredibly grateful to be under her care.

I also want to mention Dr Boughton, who has had such a positive impact on my health and wellbeing. I would genuinely be lost without her support, and I truly believe my health would not be as good as it is today without her care, guidance, and dedication. Having doctors you can trust completely makes all the difference, and I feel very fortunate to have her involved in my care.

Thank you to Dr Boughton, and the whole team for the consistently outstanding service you provide.

To anyone who is looking to join the surgery, do not hesitate and take the step. You will not regret it and will receive first class care.
